notes: Ask Crisp about your clip and it answers instead of starting a render — “what resolution is it” used to kick off a 4K upscale. Describing your footage no longer runs a job either: “my clip is 4k” planned an upscale to 8K, and “the montage came out wrong” re-ran the same montage. Complaints still work as before — “the video is blurry” enhances, and now every way of saying a clip is shaky reaches the stabiliser.
